# Johor Bahru Property Portal (jbpropertyportal.my)

> Buying guides for Singapore and foreign buyers of new-launch homes in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, near the Johor Bahru–Singapore RTS Link and the Causeway (CIQ): 10 articles, 5 area guides and 4 developer profiles in English, Simplified Chinese (/zh) and Traditional Chinese (/zh-hant). Figures come from developer records and OpenStreetMap measurements; no yield or price forecasts. The 9 project listings themselves (floor plans, prices, photos) are on jbproperties.my. Written by Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not a developer website.

## Note
Official project listings (floor plans, prices, photos) are on https://www.jbproperties.my/project/<slug>; this site holds the buying guides, area guides and developer profiles (English at /, 简体 at /zh, 繁體 at /zh-hant). Distances quoted are straight lines from the project coordinates (OpenStreetMap).

## Projects (9)

### Aethera Residences
- Official listing: https://www.jbproperties.my/project/aethera-residences
- Location: Ibrahim International Business District (IIBD), Johor
- Developer: UOA Group (UOA Development Bhd)
- Type: Serviced Apartment
- Tenure: Freehold
- Price: RM1,200,000 – RM5,000,000
- Built-up: 650 – 2,594 sq ft
- Bedrooms: 1-4
- Units: 786
- Floors: 52
- Completion: Under Construction 2029
- About: Rising above Johor Bahru's skyline, Aethera Residences blends contemporary design with everyday convenience.

jbpropertyportal.my 是写给新加坡和外国买家的新山（Johor Bahru）置业指南网：10 篇文章、5 个区域指南、4 个发展商简介，简体版在 https://www.jbpropertyportal.my/zh，繁体版在 https://www.jbpropertyportal.my/zh-hant。数字只来自发展商记录和 OpenStreetMap 测距，不做回酬或涨幅预测。楼盘资料在 jbproperties.my。联系人：Yee Woei Shyan（REN 46305），IQI Realty Sdn Bhd，WhatsApp +60 10-827 8932。
